# LaTeX `\rowcolor` Command

`\rowcolor` is used to **color entire rows** in a table. It requires the `xcolor` package with the `table` option (or the older `colortbl` package).

## Setup

```latex
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}
```

## Basic Syntax

```latex
\rowcolor{<color>}
```

## Basic Example

```latex
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}

\begin{document}

\begin{tabular}{|l|c|r|}
    \hline
    \rowcolor{yellow} Name & Age & Score \\
    \hline
    Alice & 25 & 90 \\
    \rowcolor{gray!20} Bob & 30 & 85 \\
    Charlie & 22 & 95 \\
    \rowcolor{gray!20} Diana & 28 & 88 \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}

\end{document}
```

## Alternating Row Colors

```latex
\rowcolors{<starting row>}{<odd color>}{<even color>}
```

```latex
\begin{document}

\rowcolors{2}{gray!15}{white}  % Start at row 2, alternate gray/white
\begin{tabular}{|l|c|r|}
    \hline
    \rowcolor{blue!30} \textbf{Name} & \textbf{Age} & \textbf{Score} \\
    \hline
    Alice   & 25 & 90 \\
    Bob     & 30 & 85 \\
    Charlie & 22 & 95 \\
    Diana   & 28 & 88 \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}

\end{document}
```

## Custom Colors

```latex
\definecolor{headerblue}{RGB}{70, 130, 180}
\definecolor{lightgray}{gray}{0.9}

\begin{tabular}{|l|c|r|}
    \hline
    \rowcolor{headerblue} \color{white}\textbf{Name} & \color{white}\textbf{Age} & \color{white}\textbf{Score} \\
    \hline
    \rowcolor{lightgray} Alice & 25 & 90 \\
    Bob & 30 & 85 \\
    \rowcolor{lightgray} Charlie & 22 & 95 \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}
```

## Partial Opacity / Tints

```latex
\rowcolor{red!25}    % 25% red (light red)
\rowcolor{blue!10}   % 10% blue (very light blue)
\rowcolor{green!50}  % 50% green
```

## Related Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `\rowcolor{color}` | Colors an **entire row** |
| `\cellcolor{color}` | Colors a **single cell** |
| `\columncolor{color}` | Colors an **entire column** (used in column spec) |
| `\rowcolors{n}{c1}{c2}` | **Alternating** row colors |

## Column Color Example

```latex
\begin{tabular}{|>{\columncolor{yellow}}l|c|r|}
    ...
\end{tabular}
```

## Key Notes

- `\rowcolor` must be placed **at the beginning** of the row (before any cell content).
- **Priority**: `\cellcolor` > `\rowcolor` > `\columncolor`
- Works with `tabular`, `tabularx`, `longtable`, etc.
- The `[table]` option for `xcolor` automatically loads `colortbl`.
